newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld sets terms for preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld sets terms for preferred shares.

text.p: Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc said on Tuesday its board had set a 10 percent per annum dividend rate for its preferred shares in the first three years and 8.0 percent per annum in the next two years.
Megaworld told the Philippine Stock Exchange the dividends are payable every quarter.
The real estate developer earlier announced it had set up 4.0 billion pesos worth of preferred shares with a par value of one peso apiece. The shares are part of its newly authorised capital.
The preferred shares are convertible to common shares two and a half years from the date of issue. A mandatory redemption will be imposed at the end of the fifth year.
The conversion ratio shall be computed by dividing the aggregate value of the preferred shares by the conversion price. The conversion price has not yet been set.
